blocks: Changelog
New features, improvements, and fixes. Discover how Allo evolves every week to better serve your team.
October 2, 2026
Your calls on mobile now open full screen

When you pick up a call on your phone, it now opens full screen instead of the small bar at the top. From that screen you can pause the recording and start it again, and when you call from a line with a verified caller ID, you see the number the other person sees. Swipe down or tap the arrow to go back to the small bar. On iOS and Android, from version 4.8.
Shipped by Alejandro Maggi
See every appointment your AI receptionist booked

Your AI receptionist books appointments while you’re busy. Open your agent and its Overview now lists the upcoming meetings it set up , all in one place. After the appointment, your callers can also confirm on their booking page that they showed up. On web and desktop.
Shipped by Mario Lucchelli
Gong, Jobber, JobNimbus, eWay-CRM and Follow Up Boss now connect to Allo

Jobber, JobNimbus, Follow Up Boss and eWay-CRM now connect to Allo. Each call lands on the right contact in your CRM, with its AI summary and recording, so nobody has to type a note. And if your sales team works in Gong, every recorded Allo call now goes there too, on the rep who handled it. On web and desktop.
Shipped by Leo Guerberg
Registering to text in the US takes fewer steps

To text customers in the US, your business has to be registered first. That form is now one guided flow : tell us what your texts are for and how people said yes to receiving them, and Allo writes the description and the sample messages for you. Fewer questions, problems flagged before you submit, and sole proprietors no longer need a website. For US numbers, in Settings > Register for SMS.
Shipped by Nicolas Garnil
Calls to the French overseas departments are now included in your plan

Calling a customer in Guadeloupe, Martinique, French Guiana or Réunion from your French Allo number? These calls are now included in your plan , like a call within France, instead of being billed as international. For French numbers.
Shipped by Franco Pinto
Fixes & Improvements

Calls : The keypad is now in the small floating call window, so you can dial an extension or get through a phone menu without going back to the main window. The Integrations column is also back in your calls list, showing whether each call reached your CRM.
Mobile : Calling from a contact or a search result now dials from the line you’re on, instead of asking every time. The app also asks before it syncs your phone’s contacts with Allo.
Texts : Some special characters make a text cost more to send. Allo now swaps them for a standard version automatically, so you pay less for the same message.
Contacts : Give a contact several phone numbers, each with its own country, and create their company right from the form.
Power Dialer : Long call lists no longer freeze it on the web, and names, companies and photos show for the whole queue as soon as it loads.
Line status : “Busy mode” is now called Line mode (Standard or Closed), and your personal Do Not Disturb is now called Away.
September 16, 2026
React to a text without sending another one

Until now your customers could react to your messages and all you got was a line of text saying someone liked what you wrote. It goes both ways now: pick a reaction on any message and it lands on the other side, the way it does in any messaging app. Handy when a customer confirms an appointment and all you need to say is “got it”. On desktop and mobile.
Shipped by Francisco Depascuali
Sort your callers on more than an exact match

When someone calls you, a call flow decides what they hear and which phone rings, and you can split callers into different paths along the way. That split used to need an exact value. It now works on a partial one : a company name that contains a word, a field left empty, or anything that is not a given value. On web and desktop.
Shipped by Camille Pawlak
A different voice for each message

Your callers hear several recorded messages along the way: the welcome, the menu, the voicemail. They were all read by the same voice, the one set on the line. You can now pick a different one for each . On web and desktop.
Your Allo calls are now real activities in Attio

Your Allo calls used to arrive in Attio as a note. They now arrive as a real activity , listed in the Calls section of the contact in Attio, with who called, when, and how long it lasted. Your texts still come through as notes, grouped one per contact per day, so twenty messages back and forth stay one thread.
Allo now works with Pipeline CRM

If your team works in Pipeline CRM, Allo now plugs straight into it . Your contacts and your companies come across into Allo, photos and logos included, and every call you make goes back onto the right person's file. Nothing to wire up in between.
The Android app, more stable and faster than ever

After a few weeks spent under the hood rather than on new screens, the Android app now runs more than 999 sessions out of 1,000 without a single crash . It also takes up less memory, so older phones stop closing it on their own, and your inbox and your conversations open about 40% faster.
Signing in takes one less decision

Allo now remembers how you signed in last time and puts that button first, marked “Last used”. No more wondering whether it was Google or your email address. The screen itself got a new look too, so it matches the rest of the app. On desktop.
Contacts : Delete contacts in bulk, straight from your contact list.
Call flow : When a call is passed to another of your numbers, one click now shows what happens to it there.
August 28, 2026
Two ways to transfer a call, and you choose

When you transfer a call, you now get two buttons instead of one. You can hand the call over straight away , and your teammate picks it up while you step out of the conversation. Or you can talk to your teammate first : your caller waits on hold while you explain who is on the line and why, and you pass the call over once your teammate is ready. On desktop and mobile.
Conference calls are much easier to start

Setting up a conference call used to take some doing: you had to place a second call, then find the button that merged the two together. Now you simply invite someone into the call you are already on , and Allo turns it into a conference. The list opens on the people who called that line recently, then your team with who is free, your contacts, and a keypad if the person you need is an outside number. On desktop, coming to mobile.
Your notifications got a refresh

We refreshed the whole notification system, in the app and by email. You no longer get pinged for calls that never rang your phone: the ones your AI receptionist took, the ones that arrived while you were busy or outside your hours. And the ones you do get tell you more: who called, on which line, and what it was about . The end-of-call email got the same treatment, with the caller's number, the length of the call, where it went if it was transferred, and a button to listen to the recording.
Shipped by Pablo Giraud-Carrier
Send an SMS from your CRM dialer
Your prospect does not pick up and you want to text them. The dialer next to your CRM record now sends the SMS itself, from the line you would have called with.
Shipped by Gonzalo Rascón
Call tags : You can now tag a call from the call table while it is still running, and tags no longer disappear a few minutes after you apply them.
AI receptionist : When it promises a caller a callback, it reminds the team if nobody has called back, and stops the moment someone does.
Analytics : A call opened from your analytics shows who took it, and the tags on it.
Calendar booking : One switch turns calendar booking on or off for your AI receptionist.
Language : The language you pick follows your account, emails and notifications included.
August 21, 2026
Set up your AI receptionist through the Allo MCP

Configuring a receptionist used to mean filling in one field after another. Now you can hand the whole job to your AI assistant: connect it to the Allo MCP and ask it to set yours up. It reads your transfer rules and the calendars it can book into, asks you whatever it still needs to know, and writes the prompt that describes what you do.
Speak to a teammate before you transfer the caller

A transfer used to mean dropping a caller on someone who has no idea who is on the line. Now you talk to your teammate first: your caller waits on hold while you say who is calling and why, and the call moves over once your teammate is ready. If they cannot take it, you go straight back to your caller and nobody gets dropped. On desktop and mobile.
Threads, now on your phone

Threads arrived on web a few weeks ago, and they are now on mobile: open a thread on any call or message, mention a teammate, and answer from your phone with the full context in front of you. Push notifications carry the message itself , so you know what is being asked before you even open the app. On iOS and Android.
Mobile conversations : The conversation screen has been redesigned, and contacts and teammates now have their avatar everywhere: contacts, companies, inbox, notifications and the call pill.
Links : An Allo link from an email or the web now opens the right screen in the app, even when the app was closed, and it can point at a specific line.
Safari : Allo now works in Safari. Capturing the microphone was the blocker, and it is fixed.
Invite picker : The people you called most recently now come first when you invite someone into a call.
Power Dialer : A CSV import no longer reads a company name as a first name.
August 7, 2026
Start a thread on any call or message

A call needs a second opinion, a message needs a follow-up: open a thread right on it. Mention a teammate and they get notified, reply with the full context in front of them, and resolve the thread when it's handled. Watch threads in action . Available on web, coming soon to mobile.
See ringing and ongoing calls live in your Calls tab

Your Calls tab now shows what's happening on your lines as it happens: a new Live row appears when a call is ringing or ongoing, with who's being rung and the live status of each call. On web and desktop.
Conference calls, now on your phone
Conference calls arrive on mobile: add a teammate to an ongoing call straight from the in-call pill, and everyone sees the same live roster of who's on the line. On iOS and Android.
Your AI receptionist books with finer rules

Set up several event types and let the agent pick the right one for each situation: one calendar for support and another for sales, or a different one depending on the team size. You define the criteria, it books in the right place.
Shipped by Mario Lucchelli & Gonzalo Rascón
Search : Search now takes you everywhere in the app: a contact, a setting, anything you're looking for. One search, truly global.
Lines : Give each line its own emoji to tell them apart at a glance, including during transfers.
Android : Incoming calls ring full-screen again even when the app is closed.
Meet your new AI receptionist

We rebuilt the AI receptionist from the ground up. It answers callers from your business knowledge, takes clean messages, and remembers every conversation, so a client who calls back is greeted with full context. Connect your calendar and it books appointments directly; set your transfer rules once and it sends each caller to the right teammate. Already had a receptionist on your line? Your configuration was transferred automatically.
Shipped by Gonzalo Rascón , Mario Lucchelli , George Turp & Yassine Charai
A brand new way to set up your agent

The setup experience is brand new: pick your agent's job, give it your business knowledge, choose its voice and tone, and decide when it picks up. Before going live, place a real test call and hear exactly what your callers will hear. Watch the 2-minute setup tour . On web and desktop.
Turn any call into a conference call
Add a teammate to an ongoing call and everyone talks together: you, your teammate, and your caller. Tricky questions get answered live and decisions happen in one conversation. On web and desktop.
Shipped by Sergey Chuvayev , Camille Pawlak & Nicolas Moncarz
Set Allo as your iPhone's default phone app

Your iPhone can treat Allo like its native dialer. Set Allo as your default calling app and every number you tap dials through your business line, while your personal number stays personal. Requires iOS 18.2 or later.
Pick the music your callers hear

Upload your own hold music , choose the waiting music callers hear while your line rings, and change your ringing tone. Preview each sound, set them number by number, and reset to the defaults anytime. On desktop and mobile.
Shipped by Sergey Chuvayev
Find all your invoices on the billing page
A new Invoices section lists every Allo invoice in one place, ready to view and download whenever you need them. On web and desktop.
Power Dialer : Set an automatic pause between calls to log your notes before the next conversation, and adjust the waiting music volume. The call bar also gets clearer buttons.
Message drafts : Unsent messages now save as drafts per line, show a preview in the sidebar, and carry a Draft badge so nothing gets lost.
Voicemail greetings : Listen to your text-to-speech greeting before saving it, so callers never hear a typo or an awkward phrasing.
July 8, 2026
Take a second call without dropping the first

Handle two calls at the same time. Put your current call on hold to place or answer a second one, then switch between them whenever you need, without hanging up on anyone. The person on hold hears hold music, and on mobile you can hold or resume from your phone's controls and lock screen. If you start a second outbound call while you're already on one, the first is put on hold instead of dropped.
Shipped by Alejandro Maggi & Nicolas Moncarz
See who is available at a glance
A colored presence dot now shows whether a teammate is available, on a call, power dialing, or busy, so you always know the right moment to reach out. On mobile and desktop.
Bring a teammate into a call without holding the caller

Add a teammate to an ongoing call without putting the caller on hold. Everyone stays on the line, so you can pull in help or hand off the conversation without leaving the caller waiting in silence. On web and desktop.
Live note-taking : Take notes during a call in real time, right from the call screen. They fold into the call summary and are easy to share afterward. Now on for every workspace.

Notes on mobile : Leave internal notes, @mention a teammate, and get a notification the moment someone mentions you, now from your phone, with a notification center that gathers every mention in one place.
Power Dialer : Pause a calling session and resume it later right where you left off, no need to rebuild your queue.
A brand new Allo on iOS and Android

The Allo mobile app got a complete refresh, rebuilt from the ground up to be faster to move around and easier on the eyes. Inbox and Calls now have their own tabs, each with its own filters, plus a new plus button to send an SMS or create a contact in a tap. A new Search tab lets you call or text anyone straight from a contact row. A Do Not Disturb mode mutes incoming calls when you need to focus, right from the new profile screen. Plus a cleaner keypad and contact photos across the app.
Build your phone menu as a visual flow

Setting up your phone menu is a lot clearer now. Instead of a flat list of options, you see your whole menu laid out as a visual flow. Each key press is its own step you can route anywhere: ring a line, forward the call, hand off to your AI receptionist, or send to voicemail. Edit any step from a single side panel, including the greeting and who can skip the menu. Your existing menus moved over exactly as they were, so there is nothing to redo. Available on web and desktop.
Shipped by Camille Pawlak & Sergey Chuvayev
Never miss a mention with the Notification Center

Last week we shipped mentions and contact notes. They were just the beginning. The new Notification Center brings them together in one place, so the moment a teammate tags you, you see it and can jump right into the conversation.
A clearer Numbers page in Settings

Your Numbers page in Settings got a clean redesign for clarity: a simple card list, grouped just like in the switcher. You can favorite, mute or hide a line straight from the page. Available on the desktop app.
Long calls : Long calls no longer freeze, even during long conversations.
SMS media : A landscape image sent by SMS now displays the right way up.
iOS 26 : Fixed tab labels being misplaced or cut off on first load.
Edit your AI call summaries, now on mobile

Summary templates are now on mobile, not just desktop. Apply your default or a custom template right from a call, rewrite a summary with your own prompt, and on iOS use the native writing tools to polish it in a tap.
Route callers to a teammate or another line

Your phone menus (IVR) can now send a caller straight to a specific teammate, or forward them to another line in your workspace. Set it up once and every caller lands exactly where they should. Available on web and mobile.
Shipped by Sergey Chuvayev , Nicolas Moncarz & Alejandro Maggi
Upload a CSV to your Power Dialer

Feeding the Power Dialer is faster than ever. Drop in a CSV, map your columns, and your contacts are ready to dial, with a live count of valid numbers before import. You can also resume a session right where you left off.
Never miss an iOS call to Do Not Disturb

When iOS Focus or Do Not Disturb hides an incoming call, Allo keeps it ringing on your other devices instead of declining it everywhere. If a call is silenced on your phone, you get a notification with the caller's name and number, tap it to open the conversation.
Click to Call : Choose your default line for click-to-call from your CRM or the Chrome extension (desktop).
Inbox : Favorite, mute, or hide your lines straight from the inbox switcher.
Ring time : Now configurable across all ringing modes (web & desktop).
HubSpot dialer : Rebuilt, with transfer and tagging right from the dialer.
iOS : Smoother call audio, a crash fix, and fixed editing and deleting a contact's phone numbers.
June 5, 2026
Introducing the Power Dialer

Automate your call queue and lift your call volume by up to 300%, without the fatigue. We replaced harsh ringtones with smooth background music that fades the moment someone picks up or you hit a voicemail, so you can chain calls without losing focus. Now available to everyone after a successful beta.
Shipped by Franco Pinto , Gonzalo Rascón & George Turp
A fresh desktop navigation

Open Allo on desktop and you'll find a refreshed navigation, shaped around how you actually work. Switch lines from the top, with Search and the Dialer always one click away (press K to open the Dialer from anywhere). Calls and Summaries now live in the main bar instead of being buried under a tab, and shared Contacts, Analytics, and Settings are grouped together. A new Members section lists your teammates, the foundation for the online, busy, and in-call indicators coming next.
Shipped by George Turp & Camille Pawlak
Introducing Allo MCP

Plug Allo into your favorite AI. Drop our MCP server into Claude, Cursor, Codex, VS Code, or any compatible AI client, and it can search your call history, send SMS from your Allo numbers, manage tags, and pull team analytics, all from chat. The easiest way to put your whole phone system inside the AI you already use.
Your Call Summaries, Your Way

Call summaries got three big upgrades. Editable and synced with your CRM: edit any AI summary, add your own notes, and every change syncs to your CRM in real time. Four built-in templates rewrite your summary based on the conversation you just had: cold call, sales call, support call, and discovery call. Custom templates per line: create your own template, pick the sections you need, and set it as the default for any Allo number. Every future call on that line follows your structure.
Shipped by Nicolas Moncarz , Camille Pawlak & Sergey Chuvayev
Allo Is Now Open to Builders

Allo is now a platform. Third-party developers, agencies, and partners can build their own apps, workflows, and AI agents on top of Allo's calling, SMS, and intelligence infrastructure. Custom dashboards, internal tools that listen to every call, AI agents that trigger actions on a keyword: it's all on the table now. Talk to us if you have an idea you want to build.
Introducing the Allo Academy

We launched the Allo Academy: a growing library of free, on-demand courses for any business that relies on the phone. The first course is live: Cold Calling in 2026 , built with Pauline Perez . It's free, hands-on, and built for managers and heads of sales who want to coach their reps better.
April 30, 2026
Build Any Allo Integration with Webhooks

Webhooks are live. Your team can now build any Allo integration on top of every event: calls (received, missed, completed with full transcript and recording), SMS, tags, and contacts. Push events into any tool that accepts a URL: Slack, Make, Zapier, n8n, a custom CRM, a data warehouse, or your own backend. Open Settings > Webhooks to get started.
Call from Salesforce, Without Leaving Salesforce

The Allo dialer now lives inside Salesforce. Click a contact to call out, pick up inbound calls without switching tabs, and see who's on the line right next to the record you're working on. Recordings, transcripts, AI summaries, and call metadata sync back to the contact and activity timeline automatically.
Your Calls and Summaries, Synced to Intercom

Every call you make or receive in Allo now lands in Intercom as a conversation, with the recording, transcript, and AI summary attached. Your support team gets the full customer story, voice plus chat, without leaving Intercom. Your Intercom contacts also import into Allo automatically, so you know who's calling before you pick up.
All Your Number Settings, on a Single Page

We rebuilt the number settings from the ground up. No more digging through menus and sub-menus to find the toggle you need. Voicemail, business hours, call routing, IVR: everything for a given number now lives on one unified page. Faster to navigate, easier to scan, and a lot less clicking.
Shipped by Camille Pawlak & Fahyik Yong
Canada to Canada SMS, No 10DLC Required
Canadian numbers without 10DLC registration can now send SMS to other Canadian numbers. One less hurdle for our Canadian teams who text within the country.
Compliance, Visible to Your Whole Team
Managers and members can now see the compliance section, not just admins. Anyone on the team can check 10DLC and brand registration status without pinging an admin.
April 16, 2026
Sender ID Self-Serve for France

French number users can now register a Sender ID directly from the app. Your automated SMS will display your company name instead of a generic phone number. Head to your new Compliance tab, submit your brand name and a sample message, and you're typically approved within 48 hours. This also unlocks missed call auto-replies for French numbers.
Interactive Data in SMS

Phone numbers, emails, websites, and addresses in your SMS are now interactive. Tap a phone number to see the matching contact or create one. Tap an email to open your mail client. Tap a URL to see a rich preview. Tap an address to open it in Maps. Works for sent and received messages. Available on iOS.
Contact Details Extracted from Every Call

Allo's AI now extracts structured data from your call transcripts automatically: company name, website, email, phone number, and more. All clickable. We also improved summary sharing: public links now include the full transcript, and you can call or view a contact directly from the summary page.
Shipped by Mario Lucchelli & Sergey Chuvayev
Summaries : You can now copy each section of your call summaries and transcripts individually.
Keypad : Paste a number from your clipboard in one tap, and see suggested contacts as you type.
Calls : Fixed ghost calls that wouldn't hang up. The inbox now refreshes instantly after every call.
Call Feedback : A distinct sound now tells you whether a number is out of service or just busy.
IVR : Your inbox now shows which phone menu option the caller selected before reaching you.
March 26, 2026
New Call UI on iOS

Your iOS call screen just got a complete makeover. The new interface shows caller info, call duration, and quick actions all in one clean view. Transferring calls, putting someone on hold, or switching to your AI receptionist is now just a tap away.
Designed and shipped by Pablo Giraud-Carrier & George Turp
Choose Which Streak Pipelines Get Your Calls
If you use Streak, you can now select exactly which pipelines receive your call data. Keep your sales pipeline in sync while leaving others untouched. More control, less clutter.
Busy Mode on Web
Need to focus? Busy mode is now available on the web app. Toggle it on and incoming calls go straight to voicemail or your AI receptionist. No interruptions, no missed context.
Shipped by George Turp
Instant SMS Notifications
New SMS? You'll know right away. Allo now sends you a push notification the moment an SMS arrives, so you never miss a message from a prospect or customer.
Shipped by Nicolas Moncarz & Pablo Giraud-Carrier
Pipedrive : Fixed a collision issue between contacts and companies during CRM sync.
Streak : Resolved duplicated call entries in Streak pipelines.
Streak : Call summaries now render properly instead of showing raw HTML.
Zoho CRM : Fixed connectivity issues for US-based accounts.
iOS : Fixed a bug where the phone kept ringing after the call was answered on desktop.
iOS : Resolved an issue preventing outbound calls early in the morning.
February 17, 2026
CRM Custom Properties

Your CRM data, right inside Allo. You can now see and filter your CRM custom properties directly in your contacts and companies tables. No more tab-switching to check a deal stage or lead status. Works with HubSpot and Attio today, with more CRMs coming soon.
Shipped by Gonzalo Rascón , Leo Guerberg & Nicolas Moncarz
Global Search on Desktop
Hit Cmd+K (or Ctrl+K) and search across everything: contacts, companies, and conversations, from one place. No more digging through different tabs. Available on Desktop.
Designed and shipped by Camille Pawlak & Gonzalo Rascón
CRM Sync Visibility
You can now see exactly which calls have been synchronized to your CRM. No more guessing whether a call was logged. Allo shows you the sync status directly, so you always know your CRM is up to date.
Faster, More Stable Infrastructure

We've deployed significant database cache and query improvements to reduce latency during peak hours. The app should feel snappier and more responsive, especially when your whole team is active at the same time.
January 27, 2026
Team Page, Redesigned

Managing your team just got easier. We've completely refreshed the Team page with a new edit member flow. Assign roles and phone numbers in a few clicks. Everything is clearer, faster, and more intuitive.
Built by Sergey Chuvayev & Nicolas Garnil , designed by George Turp
New Integration: Claap
Claap users, this one's for you. Connect your Allo account to Claap and automatically sync your call recordings for AI-powered insights and collaboration.
New Incoming Call Popup
Never miss a call again. When someone calls you, a new popup window appears on your screen — even if Allo is minimized. Answer or decline without switching tabs. Available on Desktop.
Shipped by Fahyik Yong
Better HubSpot Sync

Your biggest complaint was duplicate calls cluttering your CRM. Fixed. Allo now pushes only one call to HubSpot, associated to each entity. We've also added call transcripts for new HubSpot connections, making your entire conversation searchable and organized.
Contact API & Webhooks

For developers: we've expanded our API with new contact endpoints and webhook events. Programmatically create and update contacts in Allo, and get notified when contacts are created or updated in real-time.
January 20, 2026
Automatic SMS Replies

Never miss a lead again. When you miss a call, Allo can now send a text message automatically. Set up two distinct messages: one for missed calls during business hours, and another for calls outside your working hours. Available on Desktop for US numbers. Coming soon to mobile.
Shipped by Fahyik Yong & Nicolas Moncarz
New Integration: Streak CRM
If you run your pipeline in Gmail, this one's for you. Allo now integrates with Streak CRM. Sync your contacts, log calls automatically, and keep your deals moving without switching tabs.
SMS, Upgraded

We've made texting in Allo more powerful. Try Again & Delete: If a message fails to send, you can now retry it instantly or remove it from the conversation. Link Previews: URLs you share now display rich previews, making your messages more engaging. Available on Desktop. Coming soon to mobile.
Find Contacts Faster
You can now filter and sort your contacts however you like. By name, company, last activity, or any other criteria. Find the right contact in seconds. Available on Desktop. Coming soon to mobile.
January 7, 2026
Team Onboarding Reimagined

Admins can now assign roles and configure phone numbers directly from the invite form. You can assign a new line or share existing numbers immediately. New users land in a workspace that is already set up for them.
Desktop Analytics 2.0
We rebuilt the dashboard to give you actionable insights on your team's performance. View heatmaps, answer rates, and team leaderboards. Switch instantly between inbound and outbound views.
One View for All Contacts
The division between "Allo contacts" and "Integration contacts" is gone. The design has been completely rethought for a true CRM experience with a new table view and smoother creation experience.
Shipped by Gonzalo Rascón & designed by Camille Pawlak
Shared Numbers : Fixed an issue preventing users from sharing numbers they didn't own.
Call Recordings : Resolved a visual bug where some available recordings appeared as "disabled."
Desktop App : Added the ability to manually check for updates within the app.
December 22, 2025
The Allo API is live
